turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
What went through your mind then?
I took out Denise's blue coat and it still smells of her perfume.
What went through your mind then?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I think so, yes.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Tell me more about that.
There is no whisky in the house now, I gave the last bottle to my neighbour.
Tell me more about that.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
What happened next?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Take your time.
Joy offered to fly back for the review meeting and for Biscuit.
What went through your mind then?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. It is not easy to talk about.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
What went through your mind then?
I decided with the vet that we will put Biscuit to sleep next Friday, and I am dreading it.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
